Subject: Fwd: Notes — Ishaan Kapoor reference (Juniper)

Forwarding notes from today's call with Juniper. Short summary up top, full bullets below. I filled the ref_check_template and saved to the candidate folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/REFS-ISH-KAP-2026/notes-20260702-ishaans-ref.md

Summary (TL;DR): Strong operational ownership, solid debugging under pressure, worked across infra and platform teams. No major flags; recommended band: Senior II / Senior+.

Notes: 
- Relationship: Juniper was Ishaan’s manager at Parallax (2018–2021). Worked together on infra rewrite and a high-severity incident in 2019.
- High-impact project: Led stateful upgrade of regional queueing subsystem; reduced mean job latency by ~40% and improved pipeline reliability during peak. Juniper called this "single biggest product stability win" Ishaan owned.
- Incident/postmortem behavior: During a P0 outage, Ishaan owned triage, wrote a clear incident timeline, and proposed a staged rollback plus mitigations. Demonstrated calm communication with stakeholders and a follow-up postmortem with actionable remediation items.
- Collaboration: Strong cross-team communicator; helped onboard two SDEIs and ran weekly office hours for on-call rotation.
- Feedback & growth areas: Needs to be more proactive about long-term design tradeoffs (leans toward pragmatic short-term fixes) but showed learning on later projects.
- Culture fit: Aligns with our emphasis on operational excellence and documentation.

Action items: 
- Vanessa: attach completed notes to the candidate profile and flag for hiring committee packet.
- Lauren: consider Rishi Patel's reference only if committee wants additional signal on leadership.

Attachment: ishaans_ref_notes.md

—Marcus
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
